hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -q 'composer\.lock$' && { echo 'composer.lock is generated: change it only through composer (composer require / composer update), never by hand.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "" | test("\\.github/workflows/")) and ([.tool_input.content, .tool_input.new_string, .tool_input.edits[]?.new_string] | map(. // "") | join("\n") | test("pull_request_target"))' >/dev/null && { echo 'Never use pull_request_target: it hands the repo secrets to fork PRs. Use pull_request (AGENTS.md).' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

in=$(cat); printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE '\bgit\b.*\b(commit|push)\b' && [ "$(git -C "$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.cwd // empty')" branch --show-current)" = main ] && { echo 'On main: commit on a branch and merge through a PR (AGENTS.md). Run git checkout -b on its own first.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case $c in *pull_request_target*) case $c in *.github/workflows*) echo 'Never use pull_request_target: it hands the repo secrets to fork PRs. Use pull_request (AGENTS.md).' >&2; exit 2;; esac;; esac; exit 0
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep '\.php$' | xargs -r -d '\n' vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --path-mode=intersection --show-progress=none -q
